## About this board

Pimoroni's 53x11 RGB matrix — **583 individually addressable pixels** — driven
by a Pico 2 W (RP2350) on the back of the same board, with the A/B/C/D buttons
and the volume and brightness pairs along the edge.

The matrix is the board: only six pins appear in the map below, because
everything else is the panel and its driver. Projects here are about what you
draw on 583 pixels, not about what you wire.

## Start here

[GPIO heartbeat](https://velxio.dev/example/galactic-unicorn-blink) is the
board's simplest sketch and the quickest confirmation that it runs.
